title: Match the query shape to the right prototype and recolor it
written_solution: Split the input into three panels. The first two panels each contain a labeled exemplar shape; the label is the color in the panel's top-left corner. Compare the query shape in the third panel against the exemplar shapes up to rotation and reflection, then recolor the entire query shape with the matching label color.
